body:
madison square garden, sold out in roughly 60 seconds. she was 19. the fearless tour's new york stop opened with a marching band and ended in a waterfall onstage.

why: Every claim traces to the Vault fearless item "Madison Square Garden, sold out in about a minute" (slug msg-sold-out-minute, sourced Country Standard Time + Rolling Stone in the item context: ~60-second sellout, marching-band opening, waterfall ending, "coronation" framing). Age 19 at the Aug 27, 2009 show follows from her Dec 13, 1989 birthday. Photo: real credited Getty photo of Taylor AT THAT EXACT SHOW (lenses.ts fearless entry, MSG August 2009). 2026-08-12 Taylor-photo standard.
